snippet.title: Strange Zoo Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to **Strange Zoo** — the zoo management game where absolutely nothing stays normal for long. 🦁🛸🌪️

Build your own zoo from the ground up, create enclosures, care for your animals, attract visitors, expand your facilities and grow your collection with **over 40 animal species**.

But this is no ordinary zoo.

Give your animals a personality by **recording your own voice and sounds for them**, breed rare variants, upgrade your park and deal with whatever chaos comes your way.

🔥 Fires
🌪️ Tornadoes
☄️ Meteor showers
🛸 UFO abductions
🌎 Earthquakes
🦊 Animal attacks
…and plenty of other unexpected events.

Every zoo can turn into a completely different story. Build a peaceful animal paradise, become a master breeder, make a fortune, attract massive crowds — or switch to **Chaos Mode** and simply try to survive.

Can you build the ultimate zoo when the whole world seems determined to destroy it?

🎮 **Strange Zoo — available on Steam**
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4210110/Strange_Zoo/

⭐ Add Strange Zoo to your Steam Wishlist and help support the game!
